description: Basis Theory org-wide Renovate config preset

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security updates bypass minimumReleaseAge per Renovate docs (https://docs.renovatebot.com/key-concepts/minimum-release-age/#what-happens-to-security-updates). No override attempted here.

packageRules.description: Group all non-major updates into a single PR
Require Dependency Dashboard approval before opening major update PRs

Skip digest pinning for aquasecurity/* GitHub Actions. The aquasecurity org enforces a GitHub IP allow list that blocks Renovate's digest lookups from Modal egress, which Renovate logs at ERROR level and uses as grounds to exit non-zero — triggering warning summaries in #dependency-prs. Tag-based version updates still flow through normally; only the SHA-pin step is skipped.
